3.why: BassMaster.cpp:241 adds a fifth of its voltage to the high width and clamps the result to 0 to 2

comment: Params 9 and 10, master gain and mix, exist on this model but have no control on the panel and no effect on the sound; they are drawn and used on BassMaster. The width CV inputs move the width by one fifth of a unit per volt, added to the knob, so 10V covers the whole 0 to 2 range from the bottom.
